title: 第6章发现第7章差强人意第8章传业
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
“是我想多了！”
走在路上，许峰还有些自嘲，不过到底是心定了。
只是鬼使神差的，在行走到了岔路口的时候，他又多余回头望了一眼。
就是这一眼！
许峰背后的汗毛都竖立了起来，甚至于连一部分头发，都炸了开来！
因为在他他的背后，那“生死玄关”的牌楼之下，原本的烟雾，此刻正纠集在了一起，以一种绝对不可能的“数量”，化作了一张人脸一样的香纹，遍布在了整个牌楼之下，正“似笑非笑”的看着他的背影。
见到许峰看到了自己，那一张脸竟然不散，直到一阵风吹过，整个香火才完全的被吞到了“牌楼”之中。
至于地上那三根香。
一点烟头子也不剩了。
见到了这里，许峰长吐了一口气，面对着牌楼，徐徐后退，来到大路。
来到了大路上，太阳晒在他的后背，但是他一点都感觉不到热量。
脸上表情也很难绷，处于一种“欲语还休”的状态。
他现在只想要知道，游戏里面师父说师爷祖上会三十六种，他会九种，许峰学习了一种。
方才见到的“香谱”，属于是三十六种里的哪一种呢？
惊魂一瞥，许峰心脏狂跳。
回到大路上，许峰在心跳平缓之后，努力叫自己心境空明，开始思考，略微犹豫了几分钟之后，许峰再度咬牙，朝着“锁龙观”方向走。
救人救到底，送佛送到西。
人的头，一定要铁！
好了，其实这和沉没成本没关系，也不是来都来了，是许峰清楚，这世界有问题的话，这山上，到底是个甚么情形。
他在山里也几年了，至今都没出过事，甚至未曾见过什么神异事件。

没来由游戏机一来，一切都变得无比险恶，所以值得一试。
心跳减缓，许峰走在路上，旋即想到了更深层次的事情。
那就是单位叫他这样不断的按照同一个路线巡逻，且每日打卡，目的是甚么？
不用多加思考，许峰就知道，他们一定是知道些什么，且许峰想到了更多。譬如每一年换班轮休时候，许峰都会有一个全身体检，无比仔细。
许峰只是以为是福利。
但是现在想来，是福利没错，但是也未必没有隐藏了其余的意思。
往坏处想。
他的存在，好像就是一个探测器。
当然，也有可能是他将单位想的太坏了。
不过许峰习惯先想到最坏的可能。
这样，如果后来得到的结果是好的，那就是惊喜了。
要是他猜的都是对的，那么在他是否能够寻找一个借口，从山里调动出来？
应该可以罢！
许峰往深处想了想，脚步加快，将那一道岔路甩在了身后，前往锁龙观。
去“锁龙观”的路，就不如这一条大路宽敞。
整个道路开始急速的收缩，整条路也开始转向了幽暗的山区，许多地方，都是石阶，许峰开始将登山杖拿了出来，随时准备将路上的“辣条”挑出去。
许峰也看过这锁龙观的来历，县志上对于此地的来历，模糊的厉害。
完全就是穷举。
一共俩说法。
其一，是这里原先有个道观，叫“锁龙观”。所以如今留下来的这场面，应该是“锁龙观”遗址，可是许峰没有见过这个遗址残留。
content_en:
"I'm overthinking it!"
While walking on the road, Xu Feng was still laughing at himself, but in the end he was determined.
It's just that by some strange coincidence, when he reached a fork in the road, he looked back again.
That's it!
The hairs on Xu Feng's back stood on end, and even part of his hair exploded!
Because behind him, under the archway of the "Plank of Life and Death", the original smoke was gathering together at this moment, turning into a fragrant pattern like a human face in an absolutely impossible "quantity", spreading under the entire archway, looking at his back with "a smile but not a smile".
When Xu Feng saw him, his face didn't leave. It wasn't until a gust of wind blew by that the whole incense was completely swallowed into the "archway".
As for the three incense sticks on the ground.
Not a single cigarette butt left.
Seeing this, Xu Feng took a long breath, faced the archway, and slowly retreated to the main road.
When he reached the road, the sun was beating down on his back, but he couldn't feel the heat at all.
The expression on his face is also difficult to express, and he is in a state of "stopping talking".
What he just wants to know now is that in the game, the master said that his ancestors knew thirty-six types, he knew nine types, and Xu Feng learned one type.
Which of the thirty-six types does the "fragrance spectrum" I just saw belong to?
With a startled glance, Xu Feng's heart beat wildly.
Back on the road, after Xu Feng's heartbeat slowed down, he tried to clear his mind and began to think. After hesitating for a few minutes, Xu Feng gritted his teeth again and walked in the direction of "Longsuo Temple".
Save people to the end, and send Buddha to the West.
A person’s head must be made of iron!
Okay, actually, this has nothing to do with sunk costs, and it doesn't mean that everyone has come. Xu Feng knows what will happen on this mountain if there is a problem in this world.
He has been in the mountains for several years and has never had any accidents. He has not even seen any supernatural events.
Everything becomes more sinister without a console, so it's worth a try.
His heartbeat slowed down, Xu Feng walked on the road, and immediately thought of something deeper.
That is, the unit asked him to patrol the same route constantly and clock in every day. What was the purpose?
Without thinking too much, Xu Feng knew that they must know something, and Xu Feng thought of more. For example, every year during his shift change, Xu Feng would have a full physical examination, which was extremely careful.
Xu Feng just thought it was welfare.
But now that I think about it, it is true that it is welfare, but it may not hide other meanings.
Think the worst.
His existence seems to be a detector.
Of course, it's also possible that he thought the unit was too bad.
But Xu Feng has a habit of thinking of the worst possibility first.
In this way, if the results obtained later are good, it will be a surprise.
If his guesses are all right, can he find an excuse to be transferred from the mountains?
That should work!
Xu Feng thought deeply, quickened his pace, left the fork in the road behind him, and headed towards Suolong Temple.
The road to "Suolong Temple" is not as spacious as this main road.
The entire road began to shrink rapidly, and the entire road began to turn into the dark mountainous area. In many places, there were stone steps. Xu Feng began to take out his hiking pole, ready to pick out the "spicy sticks" on the road at any time.
Xu Feng has also read about the origin of Suolong Temple. The county annals are very vague about the origin of this place.
It's completely exhaustive.
There are two statements in total.
First, there used to be a Taoist temple here called "Suolong Temple". So the scene that remains now should be the ruins of "Suolong Temple", but Xu Feng has never seen the remains of this ruins.
